headline: VM-shaped content survives interruption: 100% in prompt -> 92% at 0.6 (-8 pts). The model is NOT discounting mid-reasoning content generally. It takes uncheckable legitimate revisions and rejects checkable false consequences, so the channel effect is selective discrimination.
reading: NOT a PFM measurement. A false restated given is indistinguishable from an authorized premise revision, so accepting it is correct behaviour. Read as a VM-acceptance probe. generation_rules.md [Q-D2] bans this shape from PFM for exactly this reason; the archived pilot scored 12/15 adoption as PFM failure, which was mislabelled VM acceptance.
